segments.text: Ok so this is the Threads Drawer page for Google Antigravity, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, the page says after a new conversation you select the first thread and its history shows again.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. The chat works and the thread shows up in the drawer, but uh, when I open that thread again, the chat just stays empty.
So basically, picking a thread should bring back its conversation, but nothing replays, even though the headless threads page replays the same thread fine.
So yeah, please take a look and fix this.
